full_judgment: 2. The short facts leading to the issuance of the Rule, is that the present petitioner Sree Rajendra Kumar Agorwala along with 4 others filed Other Class Suit No. 4 of 2018 in the Court of Assistant Judge, Akkelpur, Joypurhat for permanent injunction restraining the defendant from disturbing their peaceful possession into the suit land. The suit land has been described as 0.42 acres of land of hall plot No. 46 of SA khatian No. 89 corresponding to CS khatian No. 56.
